subject: EdgeCloud: MSA redline + downstream delegation / authorization request
messages:
From: Tom Blake <tom.blake@edgecloud.io>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: security@edgecloud.io
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: downstream delegation + proposed MSA redlines

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the quick intro call yesterday. Per our discussion, I'm sending the formal downstream delegation notice and our proposed limited redlines to the Master Services Agreement and Order Form. The key items are:

- We are adding a new analytics subprocessor (StreamShift) and a metrics aggregator (MetricForge).
- We propose a narrow change to Section 5.3 (subprocessor flow-down) to allow a 3rd tier for caching providers, with standard DPA flow-down language attached.
- Requested an exception to Redwood's encryption-at-rest requirement only for ephemeral analytics containers; full in-transit TLS will remain.

Attached: EdgeCloud_MSA_redline_v2.pdf, OrderForm_EdgeCloud_20260630.xlsx, Subprocessor_List_EdgeCloud_20260630.csv

Can your legal and security teams confirm whether these redlines and the subprocessor list are acceptable, and whether you need SOC2/Security evidence for the two new subprocessors? If you prefer, we can run a short call with your procurement/legal to walk the clauses.

Best,
Tom
Head of Platform Partnerships
EdgeCloud

From: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Notice: downstream delegation + proposed MSA redlines

Kimberly / Marissa — forwarding EdgeCloud's notice. They want approval for two subprocessors and a small carveout on encryption-at-rest for ephemeral analytics.

Quick asks:
- Kimberley: can you triage the MSA redlines and confirm if we can accept the 3rd-tier flow-down language? I suspect we'll want the standard Redwood DPA flow-down and an attestation for StreamShift and MetricForge.
- Marissa: please flag any procurement/order-form implications (pricing/OrderForm fields) and whether this triggers any SLA change.

If this looks like a legal pushback, I'd like to keep the ask focused: obtain SOC2 Type II evidence and a signed DPA annex for each subprocessor, and preserve our encryption-at-rest requirement except for ephemeral analytics (we can allow in-memory aggregation).

I'll ask Tom for an explicit timeline — they mentioned they need the delegation completed before July 15.

Thanks,
Aisha
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Notice: downstream delegation + proposed MSA redlines

Aisha — reviewed EdgeCloud_MSA_redline_v2.pdf. High level: we can probably accept the delegation with two main conditions. Detailed redline notes attached (see inline in PDF):

1) DPA flow-down: their proposed clause omits our required breach notification timeline and audit rights for subprocessors. We should insist on: 48-hour initial notification, and audit/evidence rights to validate controls (SOC2 + encryption attestations).
2) Encryption carveout: allow ephemeral analytics exceptions only if they provide: (a) a documented scope limiting persisted data to anonymized aggregates, (b) a key-management plan (KM plan) for ephemeral keys, and (c) a compensating control such as immutable logs for data access.
3) Order Form: New subprocessors must be enumerated in OrderForm Appendix B; pricing unaffected but we need a sign-off checkbox for subprocessor acknowledgements.

I will produce a tight set of redlines (two-page addendum) and request that procurement require signed DPAs for StreamShift and MetricForge before delegation is effective.

Connor — can you run a quick evidence check with Security to confirm whether SOC2 snapshots suffice or if we need full penetration test reports for MetricForge?

Kimberly
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts

From: EdgeCloud Legal <legal@edgecloud.io>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Blake <tom.blake@edgecloud.io>, security@edgecloud.io
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeCloud: MSA redline + downstream delegation / authorization request

Hi Kimberly and Aisha,

Thanks for the quick review and helpful notes. We're prepared to accept your proposed DPA flow-down language with two small exceptions:

- Notification window: we can commit to 72 hours for initial notification (we typically operate on 72 hours) instead of 48.
- Audit rights: we can provide SOC2 Type II reports and a vendor security questionnaire (we use SIG Lite). Full on-site audits will require a narrow scoped right and reimbursement; we prefer an evidence-first workflow (reports + live evidence call).

Regarding the encryption carveout: StreamShift and MetricForge both store only aggregated metrics for >24 hours; we can add a KM plan and immutable access logs to the package. We'll attach a short attestation per-subprocessor.

Attached is a DocuSign envelope request link so that we can sign the addendum once redlines are finalized. We can also join a 30-minute sync next week if helpful.

Best,
EdgeCloud Legal

From: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
To: Tom Blake <tom.blake@edgecloud.io>, legal@edgecloud.io
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2026 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeCloud: MSA redline + downstream delegation / authorization request

Tom / EdgeCloud legal — thanks for the responsiveness and the DocuSign link. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment: 

- Redwood conditionally accepts the delegation once we receive: signed DPA annexes for StreamShift and MetricForge, SOC2 Type II reports (or SOC2 + SIG Lite evidence), and the KM/immutable-logs attestation.
- EdgeCloud: please update the addendum with the 48-hour vs 72-hour notification compromise noted (we need to accept 72 hours for this customer if they cannot meet 48h) and include language that reimbursement will be required for any on-site audits.
- Kimberly will upload the redline addendum into the Drive folder and share the DocuSign envelope fields to ensure the DPA annexes route correctly.
- Marissa will confirm OrderForm Appendix B update and add the subprocessor checkbox flow in procurement UI.
- Connor will confirm whether SOC2 Type II reports are sufficient or whether MetricForge requires additional pen-test evidence by EOD Wed (2026-07-07).

Target: finalize signed DPAs and execute delegation no later than 2026-07-14 to meet EdgeCloud's go-live window.

Thanks — looping in procurement and legal for visibility.

Aisha
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
